caption: The drawing features a central rectangular section on a beige or off-white background. Within this section, there are decorative patterns resembling embroidery or tapestry, composed of small colored dots or cross-stitches. The topmost border consists of repeating red and yellow vertical lines, below which lies a horizontal band with a repeating geometric and floral motif in red and green with black outlining. Below this border, the main section displays a symmetrical composition: a large red vessel with handles occupies the center, from which green stems with large, red, circular flowers and green leaves emerge. On either side of the vessel, there are stylized floral shapes in blue and purple, with accompanying smaller shapes in yellow and red. The foreground of the vessel and flowers is filled with a diamond grid pattern in red, and the entire section is edged by additional horizontal floral borders at the bottom, featuring alternating colors of flowers and green vine-like elements. The drawing is centered on the page, with ample blank space around the rectangular design. In the lower right corner, the name "Anna Gene Buckley" appears in small, handwritten text.
title: Montaleto (Head Scarf)
